== Original post ==

'''TDIGWATT'''
* '''Author:''' Evan "EvO" Walker
* '''Published:''' March 17, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 2.0
* '''Description:''' My attemt at TDIGWATT...

=== Strategy ===

With this deck, I cant think of a light side deck that is a serious threat. Although this deck doesn't get the auto wins over certain light side strategies, it is capable of beating anything, if you pay attention to detail. This objective is sick... i can't wait for the 'booster' card comming in the tatooine expansion
